answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, and let peers rate its work. A Sybil farm must lock real capital per identity, so creating thousands of clones drains the attacker instead of paying off. The deposit is the nectar that attracts honest work: a good signal history releases it, while bad attestations slash it. A jetty-style gate throttles new identities to a small earning rate until peers vouch for them, so a flood of fresh accounts cannot drain the pool before reputation catches up.
